meta.scope: Adult clinical documentation prompts; headache features also cover adolescents in the scope of CG150. Pediatric and pregnancy-specific assessment requires separate templates and clinical review.
meta.selectionSemantics: All fields start empty. Selected symptoms and examination findings are present unless explicitly worded otherwise. Unselected options do not establish absence. Not assessed and Unable to assess are exclusive states. Explicit negative options require deliberate selection.
meta.investigationSemantics: Investigation options are documentation candidates, not orders or recommendations for every patient. Record clinical indication, timing, status and results in Details. Invasive testing requires independent indication and safety assessment.
meta.assessmentSemantics: Differentials are candidates only. Selection does not establish a diagnosis. Red-flag lists are not exhaustive; no selected red flag or no listed red flags does not establish clinical safety.
meta.sourceUse: Original short documentation prompts based on cited clinical facts. Source-specific copyright and reuse conditions apply to the sources; no source publisher endorses MedLog. CDC source information is available free on the linked agency website.
